thread:
Alex: Heads-up — vendor just messaged that rack handoff for the demo pools is delayed ~18h. That overlaps with tomorrow morning's demo reservations. Need quick fallback plan and who can swap slots.
Maria: Which exact pools are impacted?
Alex: demo-west-1-pool and staging-burst-01. VendorOps said transport + customs hold up. ETA moved to tomorrow 14:00 local.
Jess: On procurement side — invoice 2026-0318-042 is missing the signed SOW, vendor is pausing physical release until signed. I've pinged legal.
Nate: Ok. If handoff is late we should try two things: 1) move scheduled demos to evening slot; 2) borrow a small slice from eu-west1-demo for morning. Borrowing needs quota check first.
Sam: I can own rescheduling if we decide evening works. What's the latest reservation TTL we can push without breaking the demo sequence?
Alex: current TTL for demo reservations is 36h. We can bump to 48h for affected ones, but that needs a config PR and a quick ok from infra-sre.
Maria: For quota check, Nate — can you run a quick inventory? Something like:
```
gcloud compute reservations list --filter="name:demo*" --format=json | jq '.[] | {name,region,availableGPUs}'
```
Nate: Running now. Also note cross-region borrow will add ~30-60ms network overhead for attendees on west coast, probably acceptable for feature demos.
ProcurementBot: Invoice 2026-0318-042 status: PENDING_SIGNATURE. Contact: vendor-ops@acme.ai. 2 reminders sent.
Jess: Thanks bot. Legal replied — will expedite signature within the hour if we confirm we need it signed to release hardware. Pushing now.
Nate: Inventory shows eu-west1-demo has 6 spare A100 slots we could lend for a 4-hour window tomorrow 09:00-13:00 PST. Region option: eu-west1 -> us-west crosscloud routing would add latency.
Alex: Option A: swap morning demos to borrowed eu-west slots (requires small network note). Option B: move demos to evening 18:00-22:00 PST in local racks when vendor is handed off. Which is less risky? 
Maria: Evening is lower risk but conflicts with EMEA folks. Borrowing is faster to unblock morning but needs a configuration change to route demo traffic through eu-west1.
Sam: I'm leaning evening unless the demo requires low latency. We have a few external customers in EMEA joining — they prefer morning.
Alex: Customer-facing demo -> keep morning. Let's borrow eu-west1 for morning, and I will open the routing PR + TTL bump. Nate, can you put a quick smoke test plan for cross-region latency? Example commands in thread.
Nate: Will do. Smoke test plan (short):
- deploy canary to eu-west1 demo slice
- run `curl` to health endpoint from a us-west bastion 10x and log p50/p95
- sample load: `wrk -t4 -c50 -d30s https://demo.example/health`
I'll attach results to the PR.
VendorOps: We can reprioritize the truck if legal signs invoice before 11:30 PDT.
Jess: I'll push legal to sign now. If they sign, please cancel the borrow and we revert reservations back to local pools.
Alex: Good. I'll open the PR: small infra change -> increase TTL for reservations + add routing override. cc @Nate @Sam. PR link will be in this thread.
Maria: :thumbsup: Do we need to update the demo runbook? Might be worth a 2-line note about cross-region fallback.
Sam: I'll update runbook after PR merges and notify demo owners. If anyone can't make evening fallback, let me know.
Alex: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4213 — includes TTL bump and a `routing.override` flag plus canary steps. Nate: PTAL.
Nate: Reviewing now, small nits but looks fine. I'll run the smoke test once merged.
Jess: Legal signed. Procurement confirms release on vendor side now. If release goes as promised, we'll cancel the borrow.
Alex: Great — leaving this open until PR merged and smoke test complete. Thanks everyone for fast turn.
Sam: I'll follow up in morning and coordinate demos. Closing note once PR + tests done.
Alex: Thanks all.
